name: Houjouin Masako
source:
A mercenary who enters the competition with the selfish desire of winning the prize money and becoming fabulously rich. Although she practices no specific martial art, she is a master of using a number of weapons, which she keeps concealed until they are needed. Among her various arms are a knife, chain whip, guan dao, spiked mace, and a seemingly endless supply of grenades.
She is a hidden heroine which becomes playable by beating Normal Mode once.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=http://fenixware.net/fab/fab_charMain.asp?id=3759&order=0]Fight-A-Base[/url].]
